# The tenet-reform loop of the Sefer redesign (2026-11-08).

# Scope: a host whose rite is asked about $TENET$. Each is what one
# action needs.
kehillah_reform_can_core_trigger = {
	rite ?= {
		has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = permitted }
		NOT = { rite_has_tenet = $TENET$ }
	}
}
kehillah_reform_can_permit_trigger = {
	rite ?= {
		NOT = { has_at_least_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = permitted } }
		NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } }
	}
}
kehillah_reform_can_ban_trigger = {
	rite ?= { NOT = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } } }
	faith = { NOT = { any_faith_rite = { rite_has_tenet = $TENET$ } } }
}
kehillah_reform_can_lift_trigger = {
	rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = $TENET$ status = prohibited } }
}

# Scope: a delegate at a sitting whose motion is a question of belief.
# He favours raising, permitting or freeing a tenet he holds or has learned,
# and banning one his rival tenet opposes; he opposes the reverse.
kehillah_reform_delegate_favours_trigger = {
	involved_activity.var:kehillah_synod_takkanah ?= flag:tenet_reform
	OR = {
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 1
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_talmud_torah is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_talmud_torah } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 2
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_baalei_hamiqra } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_talmud_torah }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 3
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 4
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_emunah_temimah } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 5
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pesak is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_pesak } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 6
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_pilpul is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_pilpul } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 7
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_geonut } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 8
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_minhag_avoteinu } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_geonut }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 9
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_avelei_tziyon } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 10
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_esotericism is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_esotericism } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 11
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_asceticism is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_asceticism } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 12
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } OR = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_kehillah_kiddush_hashem is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_book_tenets target = flag:tenet_kehillah_kiddush_hashem } } }
				AND = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban has_trait = zealous }
			}
		}
	}
}
kehillah_reform_delegate_opposes_trigger = {
	involved_activity.var:kehillah_synod_takkanah ?= flag:tenet_reform
	OR = {
		AND = {
			involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_tenet ?= 1
			OR = {
				AND = { NOT = { involved_activity.activity_host.var:kehillah_reform_action ?= flag:ban } has_personal_tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra }
